name: Workflow 1: Initial Blog Crawl (One-time per User)

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO blog_crawls (user_id, blog_url, crawl_id, posts_found, crawl_data, status, created_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, NOW())
ON CONFLICT (user_id, blog_url) DO UPDATE
SET crawl_id = $3, posts_found = $4, crawl_data = $5, status = $6, updated_at = NOW();

INSERT INTO blog_posts (user_id, crawl_id, title, url, publish_date, content, is_new, created_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, NOW())
ON CONFLICT (user_id, url) DO UPDATE
SET is_new = FALSE, last_seen_at = NOW();

parameters.content:
=Blog crawl completed but no posts were found at {{ $json.blogUrl }}.

This could mean:
- The blog has no posts yet
- The blog structure is not supported
- The URL may be incorrect

Please verify the blog URL and try again.

=Error during blog crawl: {{ $json.error || 'Unknown error' }}

Please check your blog URL and try again.
